## [0.6.1] - 2026-08-25

### Added

- Admin errors that happen outside React's own render cycle - an exception thrown from a button/switch handler, an unhandled promise rejection, or a browser extension's script getting blocked by the admin's Content-Security-Policy - are now reported to the server the same way a render error already was, instead of only ever showing up in that one person's browser console. Meant to catch page breakage caused by a browser extension (e.g. a password manager reacting to a settings toggle) with enough detail to diagnose it without needing to reproduce it live.

### Changed

- Manually adding an attendee (Attendee detail's "Add attendee" action) now issues its ticket immediately, so the "Copy ticket link" action and the Apple/Google Wallet copy links work right away - useful for handing a ticket link to someone through a channel outside Admitto's own mailer, instead of only after a ticket email has actually been sent. Copying a ticket link for an attendee that has never been issued one now also issues it on demand, the same way. Attendee detail's production logs also no longer log an error for the ordinary case of opening an attendee whose ticket hasn't been issued yet.

### Fixed

- Five toggle switches (event Mail settings' "Bounce detection", the Requirements list's per-item enable switch, and the item editor's "Active", "Requires return", and "Issue on check-in" switches) no longer regenerate their underlying element id on every click - each now has a stable id like every other switch in the app.
- The "You need a confirmed authenticator app..." message shown to a Superadmin who tries to reset another Superadmin's two-factor or password without a confirmed second factor of their own now says a passkey or security key works too, matching what the check has actually accepted since sign-in/step-up passkeys shipped in 0.6.0.
- The Scope column in Settings → Logs → Audit logs no longer forces a long event title onto one unbroken line, which used to crowd the User, IP address, and Details columns toward the right edge - it now clamps to 2 lines with the full title available as a hover tooltip. IPv6 addresses in the IP address column now wrap instead of forcing that column wide and distorting the rest of the row.
- An IPv6 address in My account's session list, or in Users → Active sessions, no longer forces its column wide enough to distort the rest of the row - it wraps instead, the same fix already shipped for the Audit logs table. A long event title, organization name, or mail template name in Users → Role assignments' Scope column or Communication's delivery log Template column no longer forces its own column to claim most of the row's width either - both now clamp to 2 lines with the full name available as a hover tooltip.
- An SMTP send failure that doesn't come back as a recognizable temporary or permanent error (for example, the mail server dropping the connection mid-send under load instead of replying with a clean error code) is now retried by the mail delivery worker the same as any other temporary failure, instead of being marked permanently failed after a single attempt. A wrong SMTP login, an unsupported authentication method, a TLS/certificate mismatch, or a malformed sender/recipient still fails immediately without being retried, since none of those recover on their own and retrying a bad login across a bulk send would otherwise repeat failed authentication attempts against the same mailbox.
- Saving Event Settings with Wallet configured no longer piles a fresh duplicate PassCreator webhook subscription onto every existing one when PassCreator's list-webhooks call itself fails - it now skips resubscribing for that save instead of doing so blindly, relying on the next successful save (or the existing periodic sync) to catch up. This was the source of dozens of duplicate webhook entries silently piling up in PassCreator's dashboard for repeatedly-saved event templates.
- A PassCreator request that never gets a response (a hung connection) no longer blocks the calling action - Event Settings save, Push updates, Test connection - indefinitely; it now times out and fails cleanly after 15 seconds instead.
- A background wallet pass push (triggered by an event-wide settings or location change) that fails for every targeted attendee is now recorded as a failed job instead of reporting success - a partial failure, where some but not all attendees failed, is still recorded as succeeded but is now also logged for operators to find.

---

### Deploy
- Container image: `ghcr.io/solarssk/admitto:0.6.1` (rolling `:0.6`)
- Migrations apply **automatically on container start**. **No manual `migrate deploy`.** Back up the database yourself before upgrading (the stack no longer takes an automatic pre-migration backup).

[Full changelog](https://github.com/solarssk/admitto/blob/v0.6.1/CHANGELOG.md)
